name: C major — open position
description: Every note of C major in the first three frets. The shapes of C, Am, G and F all live inside it.

name: G major — G-shape position (open)
description: The scale around an open G chord. The same pattern returns at frets 12–16.

name: D major — open position
description: Every note of D major in the first four frets: G major with C♯ instead of C. The open D, G, A, Em and D/F♯ shapes all live inside it.

name: G major — E-shape position
position: E shape · frets 2–5, root on string 6 fret 3
description: Built around the G barre at fret 3. Second finger on the root; index covers fret 2, little finger fret 5.

name: G major — D-shape position
position: D shape · frets 4–8, root on string 4 fret 5
description: Built around the D-shape G (xx5787). Index finger reaches back to fret 4 for the two 7ths.

name: G major — C-shape position
position: C shape · frets 7–10, root on string 5 fret 10
description: Built around the C-shape G (x 10 9 7 8 7). Four frets, one finger per fret.

name: G major — A-shape position
position: A shape · frets 9–13, root on string 5 fret 10
description: Built around the A-shape barre at fret 10. After this, the G-shape position repeats from fret 12.

name: G major — whole neck
description: Every note of G major from the nut to fret 15. Squares are G.

name: E natural minor — whole neck
description: Exactly the same notes as G major. Only the squares move: now E is home.

name: C major — whole neck
description: The white keys of a piano, laid across the neck.
